one_line: A big date headline at 0:00 plus a feeling parents share, carried by one visual transformation.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a stone ledge with a Giotto Olio Maxi box, a brush jar and paint bottles, a big white "ה-1.9" above. Voice (transcript): "הראשון בספטמבר". 0:02 cut to paint squeezed on a toddler's sole: "יש כאלה שעולים לגן בפעם הראשונה".
q1_hook.why: The date is said and shown at once, so a parent knows the moment and topic from frame one (T3, H6). Wet paint on a foot at 0:02 adds motion inside 3 s (E1, H1). But no benefit is promised yet and no person speaks to the viewer (H2, H4).

beats.what: Ledge with the Giotto box, brushes, paint bottles; big "ה-1.9"
beats.why: Date and products in one still frame

beats.what: Blue paint squeezed and brushed on a toddler's sole, first print on paper
beats.why: Odd, tactile action that raises "what is this for?"

beats.what: Pink then yellow soles and prints; "אנחנו כהורים, רק רוצים לוודא שהכל יעבור להם \"חלק\""
beats.why: Names the parent worry over fast repeats

beats.what: Purple, gold, grey prints, one per small step: "צעד ראשון לתוך הגן", "פרידה בבוקר"
beats.why: A new colour and phrase every second or two

beats.what: Cut to top-down table: a yellow footprint becomes a bee; "כל צעד בונה משהו"
beats.why: Answers what the footprints were for

beats.what: A white print becomes a rabbit, purple prints an owl, a gold print a monkey
A pink print becomes a bird, a blue one an elephant; "אנחנו יכולים להיות שם לידם"
beats.why: Keeps the pattern while the message builds

beats.what: All six animals laid out together; "להאמין שהם יכולים לעשות את הצעד הבא"
beats.why: Result and the closing line arrive together

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None asked. The caption's "תזכורת שהדרך בנויה מהרבה צעדים... קטנים" is a line a parent might send on, but nothing prompts a comment, send, save or tag.
q2_flow.why: The unexplained footprints open a question that the bee answers at 0:26 and the six animals close (H5, R4). Colours and phrases change every 1 to 2 s early, then one animal per few seconds (R3, E2). The message rides on the craft, not a list (K4). At 53 s it runs long for one idea (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. The caption only wishes: "מאחלת לכולנו התחלה רכה, צעד אחרי צעד". No comment word, question, link or save or send ask.
q3_cta.why: No ask keeps the sell light (C7, C1) and the shared parent feeling gives its own reason to send (R5). The cost is that nothing invites the send (C4), a comment or a save, and nothing says where to get the supplies.

q4_shown.what: Giotto box and FolkArt bottles at 0:00; paint on a toddler's foot and prints 0:02 to 0:25 (feet, hands, back of head only); then top-down hands turn six prints into animals, Giotto tray in frame 0:26 to 0:48; six results laid out at the end.
q4_shown.why: The supplies are on screen at 0:00 and in use by 0:02 (S1, K5). The Giotto tray stays in frame for the second half, a steady brand pulse inside the action (H3). No child's face is shown, only feet and the back of a head (S5). The six results are the proof.

q5_edit.what: 35 shots in 53 s, about 1.5 s each: about one cut per second to 0:25, then 3 to 7 s top-down shots, one per animal. Straight cuts. Drawing may be sped up. Voice wall to wall with subtitles; ends on the six animals.
q5_edit.why: Text and a cut inside 3 s open well (E1). Quick cuts within one scene, then a 2 to 5 s pace (E2). Voice plus subtitles serve sound on and off (E4), though nearly every word is repeated on screen (T2). It stops on its last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: Starting gan or first grade on 1 September, with a footprint-animal craft as a picture of adapting in small steps; serves parents who want reassurance and an activity.
q6_topic.why: A real parent worry tied to a calendar moment, voiced as "אנחנו כהורים" so parents feel understood (K6, K7). The claim is modest and carried by a craft (K4). The tone is warm, not a high-arousal peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Medium static shot on a ledge; outdoor handheld close-ups and POV of an adult hand painting a toddler's sole on grass in daylight; then a fixed top-down phone on a table, adult hands only, pastel tray at the top right.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands show each animal being made, the first-choice format (F5). Prints and animals fill the frame (F4). It is all live motion (F8), sharp and well lit but homemade (F7). Filming the foot instead of the face avoids showing the child's face (S5).

q8_text.on_screen: "ה-1.9" in large white bold at the top, 0:00 to 0:02. Then burned-in white subtitles, no box, in the lower third, one to three lines, close to the whole voice: "יש כאלה שעולים לגן בפעם הראשונה" (0:02), "לזכור שהסתגלות לא קורית בצעד אחד" (0:14), "מכל צעד קטן אפשר ליצור משהו חדש" (0:34), "להאמין שהם יכולים לעשות את הצעד הבא ואת זה שאחריו." (0:50). No CTA.
q8_text.caption: "1.9 💫". About 70 words: a reflective note on adapting, "משתפת אתכם ביצירה שעשיתי עם הבנות שלי", thanks to two brands, a wish, last line "בשיתוף ממומן @giotto_israel @superkitcraft". No hashtags, no question, no CTA.
q8_text.why: A headline card at 0:00 states the topic (T3) and subtitles make it work muted (T1). But the subtitles sit in the bottom band that buttons and caption cover (T4, F2). The caption has no hashtags and a date-only first line (T7). Disclosure words are present but last, under "more" (T8).

weak_points: Subtitles in the bottom band; almost the whole voice repeated as text; no ask and no way to find the supplies; 25 s of rapid cuts before the animals appear; disclosure is the last caption line.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a big date card over the book, then film top-down hands only, one spread at a time, ending with every spread laid out together.
not_verified: Whether the account owner narrates. Whether the drawing is sped up. Music or natural sound. The Superkit brand is not visible on any product I saw. Correction to coded file: the caption line "בשיתוף ממומן" is the last caption line, the voiceover word "ברדה" in the transcript is a mishearing of the subtitle "פרידה".
